Nocturnal.description: Adapted to soaring through pitch-black night skies and hunting in deep shadows.

features.name: Nocturnal Strix
features.tldr: Your low-light vision upgrades to darkvision, allowing clear sight in absolute darkness.

Gale.description: Built with lightweight bones and powerful flight muscles designed for high-altitude gales.

features.name: Gale Strix
features.tldr: You gain bonuses on checks against high winds and turbulence while flying.
